input_text: Need a zero-downtime migration to split users table into accounts + identities. Backfill 40M rows, keep API stable.

phases.name: Phase 0: Prep
steps: Add new tables (accounts, identities) + FKs.
Add nullable columns on users for account_id/identity_id mapping.
Create concurrent indexes on join keys.

phases.name: Phase 1: Dual write
steps: Update write path to populate both old users and new tables.
Add idempotent upsert for identities (provider+subject).
Record lag metrics (dual-write success rate).

phases.name: Phase 2: Backfill
steps: Chunked backfill (e.g., 10k rows) with sleep + adaptive throttle.
Track checkpoint by user_id range.
Run continuously with SLO guardrails.

phases.name: Phase 3: Read switch
steps: Introduce compat reads from new tables with fallback to old.
Canary switch per tenant/app.
Validate counts and auth flows.

phases.name: Phase 4: Cutover & cleanup
steps: Disable fallback reads; keep dual-write for one release.
Drop legacy columns/tables after retention window.
Post-mortem + docs.

output_text: Migration playbook: prep schema + concurrent indexes, dual-write, throttled backfill with checkpoints, compat reads + canary, then cutover/cleanup.
